label: Vehicle Stage
description: Automotive studio stages — architecture, floor and backdrop only; the light rig is a separate dimension.

items.name: turntable-reveal-hall
items.text: A reveal hall with a flush recessed turntable, its brushed-steel ring set into seamless resin flooring, matte charcoal walls curving away without a single corner.

items.name: clay-atelier
items.text: An automotive design atelier, full-size clay bucks shrouded in muslin behind the finished machine, tape drawings and section templates pinned along the wall rails.

items.name: black-water-stage
items.text: A light-sealed black stage flooded with five millimetres of still water, every line of the machine restated in a perfect dark mirror.

items.name: concrete-plinth-hall
items.text: A brutalist gallery hall of power-floated concrete, the machine raised on a low board-marked plinth, shadow gaps in place of skirtings.

items.name: led-hoop-tunnel
items.text: A tunnel of programmable LED hoops receding behind the machine, each ring a clean addressable circle of light shrinking toward black.

items.name: gallery-rotunda
items.text: A white museum rotunda beneath a glazed oculus, the machine centered on inlaid stone paving that radiates from its footprint.

items.name: drape-stage
items.text: A stage hung with heavy charcoal molton drapes that swallow every wall, the bare polished floor holding the only reflections in the room.

items.name: atrium-showcase
items.text: A double-height glass atrium showcase, slender steel columns and a book-matched marble floor spreading beneath the machine.
